DM controls

Door: click = open/close, Shift or right-click (or press and hold on a touch screen) = lock/unlock.

Break

Saving

The cottage saves itself in this browser. Start a session with the same code and it is all back.

Magic books

Enter the DM code to bring out the magic books.

The dining room and lounge have a full set (only you can take them). Bedroom bookcases start empty: tap one to choose its books, and players can take those freely. Tap a book on the floor to lock it or return it.

Lighting

How bright each room is. Lamps and candles dim with it; the fireplace has its own switch.

Colour theme

Objects

Room view

Force a player's view to the room they're in. They can't zoom out until you release it.

Everyone

Tip: tap a player on the map for all of their commands.

Players & voice

Mute: the room can't hear them. Deafen: they can't hear anyone. Direct: a private line with you from anywhere; while one is open only those players hear you.

    Move: WASD / arrows or click (on a phone: tap or use the joystick). H hides the controls. Click nearby doors and the fireplace to use them. Click a chair to sit or a bed to sleep. Connect your mic to talk: you're heard by people in the same room.
